doc: The Trial Expedition (scripts/match/tutorial.gd): a guided course that stops at each lesson with a centred card (the world waits until you press a key), then a pill at the bottom while you do it. steps: [id, the lesson's one line], in the order they are taught. detail: the plain-words lines under it on the card (%X the E ability in words, %R the rank-up keys, %N the E ability's name, %U the ultimate's level, %F interact). %W swing or shoot, %J jump, %G glide, %E the E key, %T the Boki key, %s the Boki's name, %A an ability's name; the step's key shows as a key cap beside the line. preview: the ability clip (AbilityClip slot) a lesson's card plays. alt: the line for a variant of a step (the right click with a hold, the Boki starting out). labels: the marker's caption per step. mob: how the Trial's monsters differ from real ones (hp and size up, damage and attack tempo down). need: how many times a step's action must land, shown as 1/3 on the pill.
steps: Climb up, then hold to crouch
Tap to send %s at the monster
Open the chest with the key

detail.land: This is your Trial Expedition with %s. It stops to show you each new thing, and nothing out here can hurt you.
detail.move: %s runs ahead to show you the way. The beam marks where to go.
detail.dash: A dash is a quick burst the way you're moving. Run to the glowing edge, then dash over.
detail.exdash: Jump with %J at the glowing edge, then dash while you're in the air to cross the wider gap.
detail.glide: Hold %G in the air to open your glider and float across long gaps.
detail.crouch: Crouching lets you see further, makes monsters slower to notice you and steadies your aim, but you move slower.
detail.pickup: Walk up to it and press %F to pick it up.
detail.shoot: Aim with the mouse. The counter shows your hits.
detail.utility: Your right-click ability. Watch the clip, then try it on the monster.
detail.gkey: %T is your Boki button. Tap it to send %s at a monster. Tap again to call it back. Hold it to give orders.
detail.throw: Its hit stuns, and a stunned monster takes extra damage.
detail.orders: Hold %T, then move the mouse toward Chase, Guard, Return or Follow and let go.
detail.kin1: %s uses its own ability by itself. No key needed: just watch.
detail.fight: Use everything you've learned: your weapon, your abilities and %s.
detail.rank: Every level gives you a skill point (see the gold + by your level). Press %R to rank up %N. Your ultimate unlocks at level %U.
detail.key: Chests are locked, and each one needs a key. Walk over the key to pick it up.
detail.chest: Hold %F next to the chest to open it. This uses up the key.
detail.goexit: Outposts are one way home. Only what you carry out of an expedition is yours to keep.
detail.uplink: Stay inside the circle until it's yours. Step out and the capture slips back!
detail.defend: Stay inside the circle. Step out and the capture slips back!
detail.extract: The lift takes you home with everything you carry.

alt.throw_send: Tap again to send %s at the monster
